message: ファイナルアドベント

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hnngh... heave-ho. Right about here...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All done~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, is that...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! Grandfather and Grandmother told me that you're supposed to put one of these up for Christmas.」

name: Ria
message: 「An advent calendar, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「An ad-bento? Does it taste good~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a Christmas-only calendar, right? Something about opening one little window each day or whatever.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, you're right. There are tons of windows. Let's open 'em!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, no, you mustn't! The only window we're allowed to open today is '1'!」
While guiding Sally along, she opens the window on the calendar.

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, a different picture popped out.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It has fun little tricks like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「I used to do this all the time when I was little~~. So this is how you look forward to the Holy Night Festival, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Leave it to childish Lolotte-san, I suppose\s10」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, this calendar has a very handmade feel to it... I've never seen one like it in stores.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Believe it or not, I made it myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina and Jeeves helped me out too\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Going out of your way to make one... What a kid, Lolo-chan. You really can't wait for the Holy Night Festival, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course I can't~~」

name: Synn
message: 「That puts the pressure on. We have to make it a huge success no matter what.」

name: Ria
message: 「To do that, we'll have to deal with Re-Crea somehow too!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It will be fine. If we, the Crusaders, combine our strength, everything is sure to work out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Well then, let's give it our all in both Student Council and Crusaders activities today too!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!!」

name: Ria
message: 「By the way, can I flip it tomorrow?」

name: Misa
message: 「Then I'll take the day after that--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm calling dibs on the one after that!」

name: Sally
message: 「Me too, me too!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, don't push. Everyone will get their turn~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys are plenty childish yourselves...」
